## How it works

- [statement] Treat higher concurrency as a workload-dependent tuning option. The reference says insertion workers may improve speed, while MongoDB support guidance recommends changing concurrency when resources are not already maxed out and notes that restore must recreate data files and indexes. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/database-tools/mongorestore.md · keywords: mongodump archive, gzip and parallelism flags and their restore throughput · also: https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/why-mongodump-or-mongorestore-so-slow/179754
- [statement] Compression trades CPU work for less output I/O: MongoDB support guidance says --gzip can reduce disk-write I/O when CPU is available, while the historical TOOLS-997 reporter says gzip CPU usage made backups take longer. Neither establishes a universal restore-speed gain from gzip. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/why-mongodump-or-mongorestore-so-slow/179754 · keywords: mongodump archive, gzip and parallelism flags and their restore throughput · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/TOOLS-997
- [statement] In the MongoDB community performance discussion, Stennie says --gzip can reduce dump-write I/O when CPU is available, while restore must recreate data files and rebuild indexes. The advice is to adjust restore concurrency when resources are not already maxed out; these are conditional tuning choices. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/why-mongodump-or-mongorestore-so-slow/179754 · keywords: mongodump archive, gzip and parallelism flags and their restore throughput

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] mongodump --archive=<file> writes a single binary archive; --archive without a filename writes to stdout. It cannot be combined with --out. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/database-tools/mongodump.md · keywords: mongodump archive, gzip and parallelism flags and their restore throughput · also: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/technical/archiving-and-compression-in-mongodb-tools
- [statement] mongodump --archive cannot be combined with --out. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/database-tools/mongodump.md · keywords: mongodump archive, gzip and parallelism flags and their restore throughput

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] The mongodump archive format interleaves collection data, allowing concurrent collection backup and restore through a single file or stream; it is a special-purpose format rather than a tar archive. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/technical/archiving-and-compression-in-mongodb-tools · keywords: mongodump archive, gzip and parallelism flags and their restore throughput · also: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/engineering/multiplexing-golang-channels-maximize-throughput
- [statement] For a single-collection restore, mongorestore -j maps to --numInsertionWorkersPerCollection rather than --numParallelCollections. Explicit long flags make the intended concurrency control clear. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/database-tools/mongorestore.md · keywords: mongodump archive, gzip and parallelism flags and their restore throughput

## Facts and statements

- [statement] mongodump --gzip compresses individual files in directory mode and compresses the archive or stream in archive mode. Directory output uses .gz suffixes; --archive and --gzip can be combined. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/database-tools/mongodump.md · keywords: mongodump archive, gzip and parallelism flags and their restore throughput · also: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/technical/archiving-and-compression-in-mongodb-tools
- [statement] Restore a gzip-compressed directory with mongorestore --gzip; restore a gzip-compressed archive with both --gzip and --archive=<file>. The tools do not require a separate manual decompression step for these inputs. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/database-tools/mongorestore.md · keywords: mongodump archive, gzip and parallelism flags and their restore throughput · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/database-tools/mongorestore/mongorestore-examples.md
- [statement] mongodump --numParallelCollections (short option -j) controls the number of collections dumped concurrently and defaults to 4; it is collection-level parallelism. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/database-tools/mongodump.md · keywords: mongodump archive, gzip and parallelism flags and their restore throughput · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-tools/blob/master/mongodump/options.go, https://forums.percona.com/t/percona-logical-backup-slower-than-mongodump/32030
- [statement] mongorestore --numParallelCollections (short option -j) defaults to 4 concurrent collections; --numInsertionWorkersPerCollection defaults to 1 concurrent insertion worker per collection. Increasing insertion workers may improve large restore workloads. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/database-tools/mongorestore.md · keywords: mongodump archive, gzip and parallelism flags and their restore throughput · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-tools/blob/master/mongorestore/options.go, https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/why-mongodump-or-mongorestore-so-slow/179754
- [statement] mongorestore --maintainInsertionOrder also enables --stopOnError and forces the insertion worker count per collection to 1, limiting insertion concurrency. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/database-tools/mongorestore.md · keywords: mongodump archive, gzip and parallelism flags and their restore throughput · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-tools/blob/master/mongorestore/options.go
- [statement] mongodump --archive=<file> writes a single binary archive; bare --archive writes stdout. mongorestore --archive=<file> reads an archive, and bare --archive reads stdin. A mongodump --archive | mongorestore --archive pipeline can stream the data. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/database-tools/mongodump.md · keywords: mongodump archive, gzip and parallelism flags and their restore throughput · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/database-tools/mongorestore.md, https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/technical/archiving-and-compression-in-mongodb-tools
- [statement] mongodump --gzip compresses directory-mode files individually; --gzip with --archive compresses archive output. Restore a compressed directory with mongorestore --gzip, and a compressed archive with mongorestore --gzip --archive=<file>. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/database-tools/mongodump.md · keywords: mongodump archive, gzip and parallelism flags and their restore throughput · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/database-tools/mongorestore.md, https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/technical/archiving-and-compression-in-mongodb-tools
